query: SELECT workspace_user.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM workspace_user INNER JOIN "user" ON workspace_user.user_id = "user".id WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND role_id = $2 AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".username ILIKE '%' || $3::TEXT || '%') AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".first_name ILIKE '%' || $4::TEXT || '%') AND ($5::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".last_name ILIKE '%' || $5::TEXT || '%') ORDER BY workspace_user.user_id LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7;
